App.name: BJJ Training Companion
App.tagline: A little focus. A better practice.
App.saveFailed: We couldn’t save your language. Please try again.

Auth.headline:
Keep your focus.
Find your flow.
Auth.intro: A quiet place to bring intention to your training, reflect after class, and notice the small steps forward.
Auth.point1: One focus to take into class
Auth.title: Welcome back
Auth.subtitle: Sign in to your training companion.
Auth.invalidInput: Enter a valid email and a password of at least 12 characters.
Auth.invalidCredentials: That email or password doesn’t match. Please try again.
Auth.unavailable: Sign-in is temporarily unavailable. Please try again.
Auth.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment before trying again.
Auth.devNote: Use the development password you set in .env. These are synthetic accounts with separate preferences.
Auth.privacy: Your account and preferences are private. Reference content is shared.

Today.title: A little progress, every class.
Today.description: Start small. Stay curious. Build a practice that feels like your own.
Today.focusTitle: Every journey starts with a focus.
Today.focusDescription: Choose a goal to take into class, or log a class without a goal.
Today.accountDescription: Your goals and classes belong to your account. Your interface language is saved just for you.
Today.libraryDescription: A small English reference preview, shared across accounts.

Library.title: Know where you are.
Library.description: Find a position or technique in this small English reference collection. Keep your own reminder on each detail page.
Library.searchHelp: Search English titles and descriptions. Up to 100 characters.
Library.invalidSearchHelp: Check the search text, type, filter and page, then try again.
Library.noResults: No references match. Try another English term or type.
Library.emptyPage: There are no references on this page. Return to Library or refine your search.
Library.refineSearch: This is the last available page number. Refine your search to find more.
Library.noTechniques: No techniques are linked to this position yet.
Library.viewAllTechniques: View all techniques for this position
Library.noVideos: No video links are available for this technique.
Library.emptyCorpus: The reference collection is empty. Check back after the local fixtures are added.
Library.notFoundDescription: This position or technique is unavailable. Browse the Library to find another reference.

Error.title: Something interrupted your practice.
Error.description: Please try again. If this continues, check that the local database is running.

Goals.title: Goals for your practice.
Goals.description: Create a goal, then choose one focus for class. You can change or clear your focus at any time.
Goals.created: Goal created. Choose Make active when you are ready.
Goals.empty: No goals yet. Create your first focus above.

Training.invalidInput: Check the fields and try again.
Training.unauthenticated: Your session has expired. Sign in again to save. Your draft is kept on this browser.
Training.notFound: That goal is unavailable. Choose one of your goals or log without a goal.
Training.unavailable: We couldn’t save. Your input is still here. Please try again.

Validation.requiredTechnique: Enter your class technique or session focus.
Validation.requiredOutcome: Choose an outcome for this goal.
Validation.invalidCount: Enter a whole number from 0 to 9,999. Successes cannot exceed known attempts or opportunities; attempts cannot exceed known opportunities. Counts are only available for Tried it.
Validation.invalidReflection: Choose a goal before entering a goal reflection.

Log.title: A moment to reflect.
Log.description: Record the class technique and, if you choose a goal, what happened with that focus.
Log.goalReset: Changing the goal resets its outcome, counts and reflection. Your class fields stay the same.
Log.countsHelp: Optional whole numbers, 0–9,999. Leave blank for unknown; enter 0 for zero.
Log.duplicateExplanation: This submission was already saved. The original class has not changed. Your current input has been kept; edited retry text was not saved.
Log.storageWarning: Draft recovery is unavailable on this browser. Keep this page open until you save.
Log.invalidDraft: The stored draft could not be recovered. A fresh form is ready; no stored data was submitted.
Log.draftLimit: One editing tab per account. This draft stays on this browser for your account; other tabs can overwrite it.

History.title: Class history.
History.description: Your saved classes, newest training date first.
History.readOnly: Saved classes are read-only in this milestone.

ReferenceNote.title: Your private note
ReferenceNote.private: Only you can see this reminder. It is separate from the shared reference.
ReferenceNote.leaving: Save before leaving; unsaved changes are not recovered.

error.invalidInput: Check the note and try again.
error.unauthenticated: Your session has expired. Sign in again to save. Your current input remains here.
error.notFound: This reference is unavailable. Your input remains here.
error.unavailable: We could not change your note. Your current input remains here. Please try again.
